title: Necessary Optimality Conditions for Bilevel Programming using Tangential Subdifferentials
summary: The bilevel program is an optimization problem in which the constraint involves solutions to a parametric optimization problem. It is well known that the value function reformulation provides an equivalent single-level optimization problem, but it results in a nonsmooth optimization problem that never satisfies the usual constraint qualification, such as the Mangasarian--Fromovitz constraint qualification (MFCQ).
